reviews.title: Real customer review on a awesome looking case
reviews.comment: I purchased this case a while back wanted to do a cotton candy build but months after realizing that if you're a person that likes to show off your build then this is not the case for you it's a great case if you have the room it's pretty big the cables to plug into your GPU and motherboard could be a little finicky and tedious sometimes you have to take the top off the pc every time to plug something in but if you don't have to do that a lot then it's a good case has awesome cable management good at hiding cables you can definitely make a sick build but my personal opinion is the fact that the case the shape of it inside hides a lot of your build and it's kind of clunky looking very square would have liked to see it more open same shape maybe a better placement for the power supply still would recommend to a friend
reviews.author: JaysTips

reviews.title: Amazing with great aesthetics and functionality
reviews.comment: Excellent case!  I did a build for my daughter with this case and a 7800X3D CPU.  The case keeps the components cool and looks great doing it.  Only drawback is plugging things into the motherboard is not convenient, but well worth it for what you get in return.
reviews.author: Geek
